I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your order, could I get your name and email address?
Alex Miller. A-M-I-L-L-E-R at mail-service dot com.

Great. So you can process it?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return for you. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off with any carrier. As a VIP customer, I've also waived the standard restocking fee for you.
Okay, that's perfect. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Alex. Once we receive the item, you can expect a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
